name: Chicago Vice Lords
description: The Almighty Vice Lord Nation (AVLN), commonly known as the Vice Lords, is one of Chicago's oldest and the second-largest street gang, founded in 1957 in the North Lawndale neighborhood on the city's West Side. A founding member of the People Nation superalliance, the organization is involved in drug trafficking, robbery, extortion, money laundering, and murder. It has spawned numerous sub-sets including the Conservative Vice Lords, Traveling Vice Lords, Insane Vice Lords, and Four Corner Hustlers, and has expanded to 28 states.
